name: philippines_onset_split_v1
unit: 5 km cell × Philippine local day forecast issue
leakage_controls: All records of the same incident stay in one split
Adjacent 5 km cells of the same onset event stay in one split
Overlapping 24-hour valid windows for the same fire stay in one split
Imputation, scaling, feature selection, and resampling fit on training folds only
Calibration and test preserve natural wildfire frequency (no resampling)

geographic_holdout.note: Province lists are pre-registered before any onset model fitting. They are geographic partitions only; they do not imply that labeled starts currently exist.

temporal_holdout.rule: Later Philippine dates are reserved before fitting. A fire that starts near a split boundary is assigned entirely by incident id.

row_counts.reason: No usable unique wildfire starts or credible negative square-days.
